prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet's personality and sync your companion across your devices.", "Your pet progress is saved automatically once signed in."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Learn the 3 quick gestures to interact, summon, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Click pet: open context menu | Drag pet: move on desktop | Double-click: open pet chat", "Try Desktop Controls"]
2: ["Crafting Your Pet in the Background", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will ping your system system tray as soon as your pet is ready!"]
3: ["Upload High-Quality Photos for Best Pet Results", "Use clear lighting and direct angles so our pet engine renders your pet accurately.", "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme shadows.", "Best results: Well-lit single subject photo with clear background contrast.", "Select Pet Photos"]
4: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Buddy", "Select a pet archetype to see its desktop behavior and hear its unique sounds.", "Preview Pet Sound"]
5: ["Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets", "Use the exact same email or social login you used previously to automatically restore your existing pet collection.", "Already adopted pets are securely bound to your primary sign-in email."]
6: ["Your Pet is Coming to Life!", "1. Building 3D Mesh -> 2. Generating Behaviors -> 3. Preparing Desktop Sprite.", "Generating companion assets...", "Did you know? Desktop pets can react to audio and sit on active application windows!"]
7: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Companion?", "Pick a quick ready-made companion or build a custom pet tailored from your own photos."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop World", "Your new pet lives directly on your computer screen while you work, study, or play.", "Takes under 2 minutes to set up your companion.", "Roams freely on screen | Responds to cursor | Zero CPU impact"]
9: ["Setup Complete! Claim Your Starter Pet Toy", "Finish onboarding now to unlock your companion's first interactive desktop toy bundle.", "Reward Unlocked: Starter Toy Box", "Spawn Pet on Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and rewards to entice users into finishing onboarding
